description:
Build a pre-flight voice-check capability that gates publish-proposals before they reach the marketing-crew decision queue. Enforces docs/marketing/STRATEGY.md voice canon at generation time, not after-the-fact via marketing-contrarian.

Two layers:
1. Deterministic — regex / word-list block on banned phrases from STRATEGY.md (amazing, game-changing, revolutionary, supercharge, unlock, elevate, transform, etc.). Hard-fail if any present.
2. LLM-judged — score draft against builder-voice principles (first-person, honest about struggles, specific over vague, agent-protagonist, etc.). Soft-fail with reasoning surface if score below threshold.

Surfaces:
- CLI: `marketing voice-lint <draft-file>` returns pass/fail + violation list
- Pre-publish gate inside oss-advertiser / subscription-advertiser publish-proposal flow
- Should reference STRATEGY.md as input canon — don't hard-code rules

Why: today, marketing-contrarian scores violations after drafts hit the queue, so operator sees publish-proposals that are already misaligned. Draft-stage gating prevents wasted decision cycles and keeps voice consistent.

Generalization: this enforcement substrate should generalize to design canon, code-style, accessibility, branding — see related design-language initiative work. There's an 'agent generation guardrails' capability bigger than any individual canon. Voice-linter is the first instance.

Surfaced during 2026-04-25 morning vision walk after first publish-proposal cycle revealed operator-canon awareness gap (operator did not know STRATEGY.md existed; contrarian's scoring was not visible in publish-proposal flow).
name: marketing-voice-linter
title: Marketing voice-linter — pre-publish enforcement of STRATEGY.md voice canon
